reason_text.value: Table 21-4 upper bound under peak-gain pointing; candidate for expert review, not a proven violation. Worst margin over Finnish territory (incl. Aland) grid: margin 3.246 dB, beam CDN (f_steer=, f_pfd_steer_default=). Unassessed components are listed in explanation; no whole-notice clearance.

assumptions: Caller establishes Article 5 / No. 21.16 applicability; no plan-band inference.
Peak co-polar antenna gain toward each point; no beam-pattern reduction.
Worst-reference-band antenna-input density; single selected emission, no carrier aggregation.
Spherical Earth radius 6378.137 km; nominal circular equatorial GSO altitude 35786 km.
Latitude treated as spherical; sea level, no terrain, no refraction, no atmospheric/polarisation loss.
Caller-supplied satellite latitude; the batch screens the equator/inclination extremes and the filed station-keeping longitude tolerance jointly over the grid (worst margin reported).
Pointwise modeled upper bound, not a notice-wide or nationwide compliance determination.
Peak gain toward Finland at every grid point; upper bound under peak-gain pointing, not actual pointing.
Worst margin over Finnish territory (incl. Aland) 0.25-degree grid, positive-elevation points; not a continuous-area maximum.
Group emission alternatives are maximized, not summed; simultaneous carriers and other networks are not aggregated.
Only the Table 21-4 ceiling is screened; additional Art. 5/21 provisions, RoP 21.16 steering condition (a) and temporal/200 MHz constraints are not assessed.
value.formula: pfd = P_density_dBW_per_Hz + G_dBi + 10*log10(B_ref_Hz) - 10*log10(4*pi*d_m^2); margin = pfd - limit (positive = exceedance)

value.method: Nominal GSO free-space pfd, peak-gain upper-bound screening
